verdict.rationale: Secureframe's own docs have dedicated framework pages for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS, alongside SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC and NIST 800-171. The frameworks page says each supported framework gets control mapping and automated control testing on the same platform. That directly meets the need to take on new customer requirements without adding a new tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of non-SOC 2 frameworks, explicit evidence of cross-framework control reuse within one workspace, and depth beyond one-line claims for GDPR and HIPAA.
